---
title: "Vienna Applied Microeconomics Network"
---

We are a group of Vienna-based researchers working on topics in Labour and Applied Micro Economics, with the aim of meeting frequently to discuss research and policy, and to present our work. Our [**calendar**](calendar.qmd) provides information on research events and seminars taking place in Vienna on Labour and Applied Micro topics. Our [**monthly meetup**](meetups.qmd) takes place on the first Monday evening of each month during the academic year. During our [**annual workshop**](workshop.qmd), we present ongoing research on a broad range of Applied Economics topics.\
\
\
The Vienna Applied Micro Economics Network is a joint initiative of the Central European University, the University of Vienna, and the Vienna University of Economics and Business.
